cited_evidence: Behavioural criteria require preserving record_id/source provenance and preserving upstream provenance order.
job_1 assemble_provenance source: records.append({'record_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_id': record.get('source_id', ''), 'source_weight': record.get('source_weight', 0), 'rank': index})
job_2 input evidence_sources contains record_id values s01 through s08, while input needs/coverage use record_id values n06-r01 through n06-r08.
job_2 prioritize builds rank_by_record_id from evidence_sources.record_id and looks it up by coverage.record_id; observed priorities all have upstream_rank: 0.
initial_receipt.explanation: The execution contains a fault in the upstream provenance artifact. The upstream needs handoff preserves the eight demand records, but assemble_provenance replaces each demand record_id with the source_id when building evidence_sources. Job 2 then receives evidence_sources keyed as s01..s08 while coverage records are keyed as n06-r01..n06-r08, so prioritize cannot recover upstream ranks and every priority row has upstream_rank 0. The downstream ranking symptom is caused by the malformed upstream provenance identities, not by a failed exact handoff.
